verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The ES|QL REST API docs, llms.txt and markdown docs are human-readable or LLM-oriented documentation, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
